info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Limits-v1-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Limits API enables users to access the configured limits for credit card applications within the system. This operation provides insights into the maximum allowable applications a user can submit, supporting effective application management. Typical consumers include financial institutions and application processing systems that need to enforce limits on credit card applications. This API ensures compliance with internal policies and enhances the operational efficiency of application processing.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current limit settings for applications, enabling them to understand the constraints and optimize their application usage accordingly.
